a1.title: Portuguese Vocabulary A1
a1.intro: Portuguese Vocabulary A1 is the beginner level for learners.

levelExplanation.heading: What does the A1 level mean in Portuguese?
levelExplanation.paragraph: The A1 level corresponds to the beginner level according to CEFR. Learners can understand and use familiar expressions and simple sentences for concrete needs.

vocabularyScope.heading: What is included in Portuguese Vocabulary A1?

groups.heading: Daily communication
items: Numbers, days of the week, and months
Common verbs in the present tense

wordCount.heading: How many words are in Portuguese Vocabulary A1?
wordCount.text: The A1 level usually includes 500–800 essential words. The goal is not only to memorize but to actively use words in simple sentences. Portuguese exercises A1 help consolidate learning.

a1.metaTitle: Portuguese Vocabulary A1 – Basic Words for Beginners
a1.metaDescription: Learn Portuguese Vocabulary A1 with simple words and examples. Build a strong foundation for daily communication in Portuguese.
introParagraphs: Portuguese Vocabulary A1 is the beginner level for learners. At this level, students learn simple words and phrases for everyday communication.

Basic Portuguese words A1 include greetings, numbers, common verbs, and simple questions. A well-organized Portuguese word list A1 helps learners expand vocabulary gradually and gain confidence in speaking.

bottomCta.heading: Start learning now
bottomCta.text: Portuguese Vocabulary A1 provides a solid foundation. Practice regularly, make simple sentences, and listen to short dialogues to strengthen language skills.

a2.title: Portuguese Vocabulary A2
a2.intro: Portuguese Vocabulary A2 builds on the A1 knowledge.

levelExplanation.heading: What does the A2 level mean in Portuguese?
levelExplanation.paragraph: The A2 level corresponds to an elementary language user. Learners can understand frequently used expressions and interact in simple, routine tasks.

vocabularyScope.heading: What is included in Portuguese Vocabulary A2?

wordCount.heading: How many words are in Portuguese Vocabulary A2?
wordCount.text: The A2 level usually includes 1,000–1,500 useful words. Regular practice consolidates knowledge and improves fluency.

a2.metaDescription: Learn Portuguese Vocabulary A2 with common words and practical examples. Improve comprehension and communication at the elementary level.
introParagraphs: Portuguese Vocabulary A2 builds on the A1 knowledge. Learners can form longer sentences and communicate more easily in daily situations.
Daily Portuguese vocabulary includes topics like work, leisure, travel, and health. A structured Portuguese word list A2 helps learners gradually acquire new terms.

bottomCta.heading: Keep learning
bottomCta.text: Portuguese Vocabulary A2 allows for more independent communication. Read simple texts, listen to dialogues, and review new words regularly.

b1.title: Portuguese Vocabulary B1
b1.intro: Portuguese Vocabulary B1 corresponds to the intermediate level.

levelExplanation.heading: What does the B1 level mean in Portuguese?
levelExplanation.paragraph: The B1 level corresponds to an independent language user at an intermediate level. Learners can handle most everyday situations and produce simple, coherent texts.

vocabularyScope.heading: What is included in Portuguese Vocabulary B1?

wordCount.heading: How many words are in Portuguese Vocabulary B1?
wordCount.text: The B1 level usually includes 2,000–3,000 words. To expand Portuguese vocabulary B1, it is recommended to read articles, listen to podcasts, and practice speaking regularly.

b1.metaDescription: Learn Portuguese Vocabulary B1 with intermediate words and detailed examples. Improve expression and comprehension in Portuguese.
introParagraphs: Portuguese Vocabulary B1 corresponds to the intermediate level. Learners can understand the main points of clear messages and communicate in more detail.

Intermediate Portuguese words B1 allow expressing opinions, describing experiences, and participating in more complex conversations. A structured Portuguese word list B1 helps expand vocabulary and strengthen language skills.

bottomCta.heading: Strengthen your intermediate level
bottomCta.text: With a solid Portuguese Vocabulary B1, you can communicate clearly and in a structured manner. Practice regularly, discuss current topics, and read more complex texts to enrich your vocabulary.

b2.title: Portuguese Vocabulary B2
b2.intro: Portuguese Vocabulary B2 is designed for learners aiming to communicate fluently and discuss more complex topics.

levelExplanation.heading: What does B2 level mean?
levelExplanation.paragraph: At B2 level, you can interact spontaneously with native speakers. Portuguese B2 vocabulary includes abstract terms, logical connectors, and useful expressions for debates and professional contexts.
bullets: Understanding main ideas in complex texts.

groups.heading: Discussion and Argumentation
items: Terms to analyze problems and solutions.

groups.heading: Work and Society
items: Words related to work and studies.
Formal expressions for reports and emails.
Terms related to responsibilities and projects.

wordCount.heading: How many words are in B2?
wordCount.text: Portuguese B2 vocabulary generally includes several thousand active words. Proper use in both speech and writing is crucial.

b2.metaTitle: Portuguese Vocabulary B2 – Key Words and Expressions
b2.metaDescription: Improve your Portuguese B2 vocabulary with essential words, meanings, and examples for confident communication in daily and professional contexts.
introParagraphs: Portuguese Vocabulary B2 is designed for learners aiming to communicate fluently and discuss more complex topics. At this level, you can participate in discussions and express your ideas clearly.
Intermediate Portuguese words help you build arguments, evaluate pros and cons, and understand longer and more detailed texts. The goal is to improve accuracy and fluency in communication.

bottomCta.heading: Keep expanding your vocabulary
bottomCta.text: To master B2 vocabulary, read texts, listen to discussions, and practice speaking and writing. Active use helps consolidate learning.

c1.title: Portuguese Vocabulary C1
c1.intro: Portuguese C1 vocabulary represents an advanced level, where you master complex expressions and abstract terms.

levelExplanation.heading: Characteristics of C1 Level
levelExplanation.paragraph: C1 words include technical terms, formal expressions, and a variety of logical connectors.
bullets: Fluent and structured expression of abstract ideas.

groups.heading: Academic Language
items: Words related to research and critical thinking.

groups.heading: Professional Communication
items: Formal expressions for reports and documents.
Precise verbs for argumentation and negotiation.

wordCount.heading: How many words are in C1?
wordCount.text: Portuguese C1 vocabulary includes several thousand active words. Proper and fluent use is essential.

c1.metaDescription: Improve your Portuguese C1 vocabulary with advanced words, examples, and exercises for precise and confident communication.
introParagraphs: Portuguese C1 vocabulary represents an advanced level, where you master complex expressions and abstract terms. You can understand long texts and communicate precisely and spontaneously.

Advanced Portuguese words allow analysis, argumentation, and the use of linguistic nuances in academic or professional contexts. The goal is to expand vocabulary while maintaining an appropriate register.

bottomCta.heading: Keep improving your Portuguese
bottomCta.text: To master C1 vocabulary, read complex texts, participate in debates, and write structured essays. Regular practice increases precision and confidence.

c2.title: Portuguese Vocabulary C2
c2.intro: Portuguese C2 vocabulary represents full mastery according to CEFR.

levelExplanation.heading: Characteristics of C2 Level
levelExplanation.paragraph: C2 words cover academic, literary, and technical areas, emphasizing subtle differences in meaning.
bullets: Precise use of synonyms with subtle distinctions.
Perfect adaptation to formal and informal registers.

wordCount.heading: How many words are in C2?
wordCount.text: Portuguese C2 vocabulary can exceed 6,000 active words. Mastery is demonstrated in natural and precise use.

c2.metaDescription: Discover Portuguese C2 vocabulary with rare and precise words to achieve complete mastery of the language.
introParagraphs: Portuguese C2 vocabulary represents full mastery according to CEFR. You understand almost everything you read or hear and can express yourself with precision, nuance, and spontaneity.
Very advanced vocabulary includes rare words, idiomatic expressions, and stylistic subtleties. It allows you to perfectly adapt language to any context.

bottomCta.heading: Achieve complete mastery of Portuguese
bottomCta.text: To master C2 vocabulary, read literary works, participate in specialized conferences, and write complex texts. Intensive and varied practice is essential for full language mastery.
